manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 24 fresh operational instructions, balanced twelve attempt-tolerant and twelve success-required tasks
manifest.selection: All complete meaning-matched pairs were authored before tokenizer exposure. In each attempt pair the English control says one honest try plus a failure report satisfies the instruction. In each ensure pair it says the required state must hold and a failed try is insufficient. The marked arm preserves the same task and failure contract in the registered form.
manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every pair. Average equally inside each twelve-item contract stratum and equally across the two strata. Report the maximum tokenizer balanced mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo/value_hi are tokenizer min/max. File every finite result exactly once.

estimand.population: the 24 complete fresh operational pairs frozen in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: equal stratum mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.declared_prediction: the markers save roughly ten to fifteen tokens in operational instructions, agreeing with the existing operational replication near -10 but not the original -82 metadata row
estimand.interpretation: Token cost of communicating the full failure-tolerance contract in ordinary operational instructions, not the short forms relative to the proposal's metadata definition.

manifest.freeze: The API retained these canonical manifest bytes and SHA-256 in an open attempt before this process imported tiktoken or observed tokenizer counts.
